findings.finding: Supplied latent fits, induced clusters, PAG equivalence classes and CACE effects have separate objects, assumptions and adoption choices.

Six vendor families have primary technical comparisons. Mplus randomized-trial CACE is explicitly credited as an existing causal-effect comparator; the proposal admits its missing mature model-fitting/diagnostic breadth.
Reinspected Zhang2008 primary pp1442-1445: invariant PAG marks, directed-MAG ancestry without excluding extra confounding, and explicit no-selection limit match the text.

Equal Gaussian laws with effects3/5 and0 prove a witness-based nonidentification claim, not a two-element complete identified set. Proxy slope1/3 remains biased for zero effect. Finite compliance law gives ITT6/5, first-stage2/5 and ratio3, changing to7/2 when exclusion fails.

Primary Mplus Example7.24 fixes logit thresholds plus/minus15. Its small probability is3.059022269e-7, not a literal structural zero. Manuscript states this as an encoding check without asserting a measured engine failure.

Rate/loss Gaussian example stipulates1percentage-point and1000-currency scales. Assistance example explicitly redefines outcome as net customer value and separates offer, receipt and complier effects.

Every technical claim uses inspected vendor technical text or existing primary scholarly text. Original vendor PDFs are saved. Landing pages provide leads only; five essential technical followups remain without waivers.
